sources.title: ApplAI 2026 será el mayor congreso de IA aplicada — Deia
sources.claim: ApplAI 2026 takes place 13 May 2026 at the Kursaal in Donostia with 34 sponsoring entities and Google/IBM/Tecnalia speakers.

sources.title: EuskalHack Security Congress IX
sources.claim: EuskalHack Security Congress IX runs 19-20 June 2026 at Colegio Mayor Olarain in Donostia, tickets €85-€190 across three tiers.

sources.title: EuskalHack Security Congress — 10times listing
sources.claim: EuskalHack Security Congress ninth edition targets ~200 attendees on reverse engineering, vulnerability research, mobile attacks, APTs and AI in cybersecurity.

sources.title: MUBIL Mobility Expo 2026 — official
sources.claim: MUBIL Mobility Expo 2026 ran 25-26 March 2026 at Ficoba with 110 exhibitors and France as strategic partner.

sources.title: ISC'2026 — System Dynamics Society
sources.claim: ISC'2026, the 24th Industrial Simulation Conference, runs 27-29 May 2026 at the University of the Basque Country in San Sebastián.

sources.title: ISC'2026 — EUROSIS
sources.claim: ISC'2026 is organised by EUROSIS as Europe's premier annual industrial simulation conference, integrating AI and agent-based modelling.

sources.title: Berrilan Basque Tech Summit 2026
sources.claim: Berrilan Basque Tech Summit IV is scheduled for November 2026 at Anoeta, with BIM, GIS digital twins and smart cities as core tracks.

sources.title: Donostia Week-INN — Fomento San Sebastián
sources.claim: Donostia Week-INN is the city's annual innovation week run by Fomento de San Sebastián.

sources.title: DIPC × Donostia Week-INN
sources.claim: DIPC participates in Donostia Week-INN as part of the city's annual innovation programme.

sources.title: Debug'Em All Meetup Cider House Ed. — Eventbrite
sources.claim: Debug'Em All Meetup San Sebastián 2026 (Cider House Ed.) ran 11 April 2026 at CEMEI - Donostia Sustapena.

sources.title: Tech Connect Donostia
sources.claim: Tech Connect Donostia is an International Tech & Business Meetup focused on building connections in San Sebastián.

sources.title: Tech Connect Donostia — Meetup.com
sources.claim: Tech Connect Donostia counts 487 members, 4.8/5 across 40 events at Drop, Larramendi Kalea 3, organised by Luis S., in English.

sources.title: AI Saturdays Donostia
sources.claim: Saturdays.AI Donostia runs ML/Deep Learning study cycles (7-14 Saturday sessions, 9am-2pm) at Impact Hub Donostia, €179-€249.

sources.title: AI Saturdays Euskadi — WEF Global Shapers
sources.claim: AI Saturdays Euskadi is recognised by the WEF as a Global Shapers project teaching production-grade AI to Basque students.

sources.title: Zinemaldia & Technology — SSIFF
sources.claim: Zinemaldia & Technology is the San Sebastián Film Festival's industry programme.

sources.title: Zinemaldia Startup Challenge VI — Vicomtech
sources.claim: Zinemaldia Startup Challenge is co-organised with Tecnalia, Vicomtech and ALÍA; two €10,000 prizes.

sources.title: 74th San Sebastián Film Festival — Euskadi Tourism
sources.claim: The 74th San Sebastián International Film Festival runs 18-26 September 2026 in Donostia.

sources.title: San Sebastián Convention Bureau — Conference Agenda
sources.claim: The San Sebastián Convention Bureau confirms 2026 tech/academic conferences including ISC'2026 and EuskalHack IX.

sources.title: Impact Hub Donostia
sources.claim: Impact Hub Donostia operates from Tabakalera and hosts Saturdays.AI and community tech events.

sources.title: Kursaal Congress Centre
sources.claim: Kursaal Congress Centre is Donostia's flagship event venue, 20,000 m², 1,806-seat auditorium, hosting 300+ events and 600,000 visitors annually.
